target_customer: E-commerce fashion brands (original product); private equity portfolio companies (current site)
problem: Fashion brands pay for costly photo and video shoots with models. Bezel generated virtual on-model photos and video from clothing images.
business_model: Original: AI generated model imagery sold to brands. Current: consulting style AI transformation engagements for private equity platforms.
product_category: Generative AI for fashion e-commerce, now AI transformation services

founders.name: Kashyap Achar
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led engineering at Bilt and built technology at Clearco and an auto HSA payment platform. Education not listed.

competitors.name: AI.Fashion
competitors.what: Virtual photoshoots with real model personas

competitors.name: Botika
competitors.what: Turns clothing product shots into AI fashion shoots

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating accurate garment detail on AI models for photo and video was hard in early 2025 but relied on rapidly improving public image models.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar tools (Botika, AI.Fashion, Lalaland and dozens more) competed on the same wedge, and image models were commoditizing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors in the space were well funded and some shut down or were acquired (NeuroPixel.AI wound down in 2026, Browzwear acquired Lalaland).

market_need_then: Fashion brands wanted cheaper imagery, and press in January 2025 covered AI replacing photographers and models. Several startups raised on the same thesis.

branding.domain_note: Uses trybezel.com with a try prefix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Current site uses formal consulting language

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found, and the name collides with watch bezels and another Bezel trademark and a YC fintech named Bezel.

pivots.from: AI human models for fashion e-commerce
pivots.to: AI transformation partner for private equity platforms
pivots.why: Not stated. Current company site describes only the new offering, date of change unknown.

outcome_analysis: Bezel started as a one person YC W25 company selling AI models for fashion imagery in a crowded space with better funded rivals. By late 2026 its site sells AI transformation work to private equity portfolio companies, which suggests the original product did not find enough traction, though no source states why. No verified funding exists.
notes: Funding unverified: one search summary of a YC listing said 8 million total raised, another directory said 500K; neither was confirmed by a second source, so no round is recorded. Pivot inferred from comparing YC page and current site, cause not public. Failure factors are my reading and not stated by the company; company status is Active.
